scripts.build:example: uv run python -m variable_gen.cli build --config examples/minimal/stv.config.json --style all
scripts.check:python: uv run ruff check packages/variable-gen && uv run ruff format --check packages/variable-gen/src packages/variable-gen/tests && uv run mypy
scripts.verify:node: npm run check:node && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:python: npm run check:python && npm run test:python
scripts.verify: npm run verify:node && npm run verify:python
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run build:example
